title: Blue Voice Raises $6M to Build Real-Time Legal Guidance for Police
dek: The startup, founded by a Harvard Law dropout, is building an app designed to give officers real-time legal and policy guidance.
socialCaption: Blue Voice raised a $6M seed round to build real-time legal and policy guidance for police officers. The opportunity is clear; so are the demands for accuracy, governance and agency-specific implementation.
